schools.notes: QUARTER SYSTEM, not semesters. Rose-Hulman runs three 10-week academic quarters plus finals: Fall Quarter (classes Sep 3 - finals end Nov 19, 2026; term formally ends Nov 23), Winter Quarter (classes Nov 30, 2026 - finals end Feb 25, 2027; term ends Mar 1), Spring Quarter (classes Mar 8 - finals end May 27, 2027; term ends Jun 1), then a Summer session (Jun 3 - Aug 20, 2027). There is therefore no 'fall/spring semester' structure - the 'spring term start' asked for is the SPRING QUARTER start, Mar 8, 2027, and the long winter recess is the Holiday Vacation that falls INSIDE Winter Quarter (Dec 18, 2026 - Jan 4, 2027), not between terms. THANKSGIVING: the 2026-27 calendar lists NO event named Thanksgiving. Thanksgiving Day 2026 (Nov 26) falls in the unlabeled gap between Fall Term ending Nov 23 and Winter Quarter classes beginning Nov 30, so students are between quarters, but the calendar does not label that gap as a break and I did not invent dates for it - reported as not_found. Similarly, no 'last day of classes' row is printed for any quarter; only the finals begin/end rows are published, so those are what is reported. The PDF prints month/day without a year; years above are assigned from the document title '2026-27 Academic Year Calendar' and the printed weekday for each date, all of which check out (e.g. Sep 3, 2026 is a Thursday; Jan 4, 2027 is a Monday). Confirmed as the current official file: linked from https://www.rose-hulman.edu/campus-life/student-services/registrar/academic-calendars.html as 'Printable 2026-27 Academic Calendar'.

IMPORTANT for trip planning: UMKC's public calendar feed only exposes ~180 days ahead, so spring 2027 entries were read one at a time from their individual official event pages (URLs cited). The rendered event pages compute the display date in JavaScript; the only literal date text in the served HTML is the schema.org JSON-LD block, which is what is quoted. Quoted endDate is the LAST day of the break, inclusive (verified against the feed's per-day instances: Fall Break has instances on Oct 8, 9, 10 and 11). 'Winter Break (University Closed)' is the university's holiday closure (Dec 25 - Jan 3), NOT the full inter-semester gap; the actual gap for students runs from the end of fall finals (Dec 18, 2026) to the start of spring classes (Jan 19, 2027), with a January intersession Jan 4-15, 2027 in between. Spring 2027 commencement: NOT FOUND. www.umkc.edu/commencement/ currently says 'Saturday, May 16' with no year, which matches May 2026 (May 16, 2027 is a Sunday), so the page has not yet been updated for 2027; no commencement event exists on the academic calendar.
